title: Color Ball Drop: Rope Puzzle
shortPitch: Swipe gold ropes and wooden supports to release colored balls, navigate clever physics contraptions, and guide every ball into its matching bucket.
longDescription: Color Ball Drop: Rope Puzzle is an offline 2D physics puzzle game for Android built around satisfying timing and chain reactions.

Across 100 handcrafted portrait levels and 5 chapters, you swipe through gold ropes and wooden beams, master seesaw bridges, portal pairs, color filter gates, and dye rings, and guide red, blue, yellow, green, and heavy steel balls cleanly into matching buckets.
releaseNote: In development for Android — coming soon to Google Play.

features.title: 100 Playable Levels
features.description: Progress across 5 chapters with 1–3 stars per level and earn coins as your puzzle skills grow.

features.title: 12 Physics Contraptions
features.description: Master cuttable ropes, wooden beams, steel chains, bumper pins, seesaw bridges, color gates, dye rings, and portals.

features.title: Daily Challenge & Streaks
features.description: Jump into daily puzzles, build daily streak rewards, and use the built-in hint system when a level gets tricky.

features.title: 8 Unlockable Blade Trails
features.description: Customize your swipe with unlockable blade trails earned through coins or star milestones.

features.title: Colorblind Symbols & Multi-Language
features.description: Distinct shape symbols on colored balls and buckets, multiple languages, and audio/vibration controls.

features.title: Play Offline Anytime
features.description: Designed for portrait one-hand Android play with local progress saves — no account or constant connection required.

privacy.summary: Draft policy reflecting the current Color Ball Drop build: ads are disabled, Google Play Billing is not connected, optional analytics has no configured endpoint and defaults to off, and progress is stored locally on your device.
privacy.adsStatus: Currently Disabled (release/ads/enabled=false). Fresh Android exports exclude native AdMob and UMP libraries. If advertising is enabled in a future release, this policy and the Google Play Data Safety form will be updated prior to publishing.
privacy.billingStatus: Not connected in the current build. No live in-app purchases are processed.
privacy.analyticsStatus: Optional in-game analytics starts OFF by default and currently has no configured ingestion endpoint, so no telemetry is transmitted. If an optional analytics endpoint (such as PostHog) is enabled later, players must opt in and may disable it in Settings.
privacy.localSavesNote: Campaign progress, star counts, unlocked trails, and settings are stored locally on your device. No user account, login, email, contacts, GPS, camera, or microphone access is requested.
